# Donadomains MCP

> Free MCP server. Domain search, WHOIS, and AI valuation for AI agents.

Connect: https://www.donadomains.xyz/api/mcp
Full docs: https://www.donadomains.xyz/docs
Source: https://github.com/adipundir/donadomains

## Install

Claude Code CLI:

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http donadomains https://www.donadomains.xyz/api/mcp
```

Any other MCP client (Claude Desktop, Claude.ai Connectors, Cursor, Continue, Windsurf, Zed):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "donadomains": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://www.donadomains.xyz/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

No signup, no API key.

## Tools

### 1. check_domain_availability(domain)

Is a domain free right now? If available, returns the lowest price and which registrar. If taken, returns ownership info (registrar, dates, nameservers, status).

### 2. search_domains(keyword, limit?, tldFilter?, includeTaken?)

Search a keyword across 6 registrars (GoDaddy, Namecheap, Dynadot, Hover, Name.com, Porkbun). Returns available domains with prices.

### 3. get_domain_info(domain)

WHOIS, RDAP, DNS intel for a registered domain. Registrar, dates, nameservers, status codes, DNSSEC.

### 4. valuate_domain(domain, registered?, isPremium?, registrationPrice?)

AI-powered domain valuation. Score 0-100, tier (common, decent, premium, ultra), USD range, reasoning, factors. Cached forever.

## Rate Limits (free, per source IP)

IPv6 addresses are counted by their /64 prefix.

- Overall MCP calls: 200 / hour
- check_domain_availability, get_domain_info: 60 / hour each
- search_domains: 20 / hour
- valuate_domain: 20 / hour

Per rolling-hour window from your first request. Going over returns an error your AI can read.

## Example prompts

- "Is ad402.sh available?"
- "Find a cheap .io domain for a craft-beer brand under $20/yr."
- "Who owns github.com and when does it expire?"
- "What is crypto.com worth?"

Issues, feature requests, higher limits: https://github.com/adipundir/donadomains/issues
